tasks.title: Add PDF parser for Mercado Pago credit-card faturas
tasks.justification: Implemented and merged to master (commits 208d6a5, c10c76f, ac1beb3): mercadopago_cartao_pdf parser in PDFParser, wired through Ingestor/AccountFile, plus UI parity fixes (Formatters.translate_parser_type, account edit form select) and a reconciliation-warning safety net for silently-dropped rows. Verified against the user's real fatura PDF, not just synthetic fixtures. Full subagent-driven-development review cycle completed (task review + final whole-branch review + fix wave + scoped re-review), all clean. Remaining manual step (out of scope for this task, explicitly deferred): create the .account marker file in the Mercado Pago Cartão de Crédito Google Drive folder (parser: mercadopago_cartao_pdf) so batch import picks it up.
